item.title: 'It was just an unfortunate evening' - Aiden Markram reflects on South Africa's disappointing exit as New Zealand win semi-final to book Motera ticket
item.description: "We expected the wicket to play really well. It looked pretty good to the eye," Markram said.

item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: Tonight wasn't a choke, it was a bloody walloping: South African head coach Shukri Conrad
item.description: The Proteas, who had entered the knockout clash as tournament favourites and the only unbeaten team, were completely outplayed as New Zealand sealed a nine-wicket victory.

item.title: 'Nobody will drop a catch on purpose' - Bowling coach Morne Morkel on India's lacklustre fielding in T20 World Cup 2026 ahead of semi-final vs England
item.description: Morne Morkel asserted that India puts a lot of emphasis in the fielding department. His remark came while speaking about the lacklustre fielding performance of the Men in Blue during the World Cup.

item.title: India need Kuldeep Yadav vs England: Michael Vaughan suggests massive change for semi-final
item.description: "I would play Kuldeep Yadav. Kuldeep, over the years, has had England on toast in any format. He has always been a bowler England have struggled to pick," Michael Vaughan said.

item.title: 'Their bowling is nothing special' - Former India opener gives verdict on England ahead of semifinal clash against India
item.description: The Indian legend believes the hosts can capitalise on England's bowling, but will have to be at the top of their game in all departments to beat them.

item.title: Mohammad Amir says bad things about India to stay in the news: Former India batter tears into pacer amid T20 World Cup
item.description: "We must not give them importance. There is no need for us to come down to their level and reply," Mohammad Kaif said.

item.title: 'Not afraid of Buttler' - Former India opener ignores threat posed by out-of-form England star
item.description: Buttler, who is yet to record a score in the double digits in each of his last five innings, has scored a mere 62 runs in the entire tournament so far at an miserly average of 8.86.

item.title: Bangladesh allrounder Afif Hossain set to return for Pakistan ODIs
item.description: According to a source close to the Bangladesh selection panel, Afif’s comeback has been finalised as the selectors wrapped up discussions on the squad for the three-match series.

item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: India vs England, 2nd Semi-Final: Weather and Pitch Report, Wankhede Stadium in Mumbai
item.description: India and England will meet in Mumbai for 2nd Semi-Final of the T20 World Cup 2026 on Thursday, March 05.

item.title: 'It's a contest, but not a problem' - Aakash Chopra on Sanju Samson's battle with Jofra Archer
item.description: Chopra suggested that Archer had an upper hand over Samson by exploiting his weakness against the short ball in the past.
